summary: Feature cleanup-old-viewport-code successfully removed all old viewport rendering code from katla_gfx. Viewport struct simplified to configuration-only (6 fields: label, extent, output_mode, clear_color, depth_format, color_format). ViewportRenderTarget struct entirely deleted (160+ lines removed). ViewportManager simplified to lifecycle management only (create, get, destroy). Old rendering methods removed: set_viewport_uniforms, set_viewport_draw_list, clear_viewport_draw_list, is_viewport_ready, update_viewport_camera. Unused import DEPTH_SUBRESOURCE_RANGE removed. Documentation updated to reflect frame graph approach. Net reduction: 244 lines of code (3 files changed: +40/-284). All verification checks passed: no render_viewport references remain, only viewport_texture_id preserved for UI compatibility, no ViewportRenderTarget references, code compiles successfully. Implementation follows aggressive removal strategy with no hybrid approaches or compatibility shims.
